options.player_question: I have my ID, how to get faster to the helipoint?
options.npc_answer: Helipoint? That area is a mess kiddo! Best you can do is survive here.

options.player_question: If I have a mobile I could try to call someone...
options.npc_answer: Lucky for you, take my Mobile. It's useless right now.
options.tip: Your ID may save your life

options.player_question: I can't use the boat to leave!
options.npc_answer: Leave? Are you crazy?! Best you can do is survive here.

options.player_question: How can I get this boat up and running?
options.npc_answer: Probably get fuel from the Pumps! Here is a Fuel Canister. The farther you go, the more fuel you'll need!
options.tip: Fuel the boat to the shore!

options.player_question: Hey. You look like someone who knows a way off this rock. I'm... between contractors.
options.npc_answer: What! Look at you – rags and desperation. Perfect. Listen, kiddo. I need a mule. There's a suitcase – old leather, brass locks, smells like trouble. Find it, then hand it to anyone who knows the code 'the tide is rising.' They'll pay. I just want my ticket out before the rot finds me. Everything has a toll. You in?
options.req_item: [Suitcase, Bag, Large Backpack, Small Backpack, Large Satchel, Medium Satchel, Small Satchel]

options.player_question: Yes, but looks useless right now. Do you have something to trade?
options.npc_answer: Well, well. The scarecrow delivers. Here's your payment. Don't spend it all in one grave. Some days you win, some days you lose. Today you're just... disposable. Hehehe. Now get lost before I decide you're worth more as bait.
options.tip: Scavenge around to find the lost Suitcase.

options.player_question: I think I have something that may interest you...
options.npc_answer: Have you found the suitcase? Is there a laptop inside of it? This is research and it's valuable!

options.player_question: The laptop is here, do you have something to trade?
options.npc_answer: Research has its price, take this and try to get out of here as fast as you can! Rotters and rogues around, can't trust anyone anymore.
options.tip: This laptop contains simulation data of the virus.

options.player_question: I've been scavenging after the island fell.
options.npc_answer: Everybody is. Have you found anything important?
This is what people were saying about the black market pharmas around here. I don't have much, take this Blueprint.
options.tip: The raw genome data of the flu.

options.player_question: Do you know anything about the files?
options.npc_answer: I'm trying to stay alive here, but people are talking about pharmas trying to steal some shit.

options.player_question: I don't know if you are the right person, but here it is.
options.npc_answer: The vaccine simulations! We need to get out of here fast.
options.tip: Some presentations and leaked data due to bad security and public usage.
